name: Gut-Safe "Egg Roll in a Bowl" (Peeled Zucchini Swap)
whyItWorks: Swaps rough shredded cabbage for peeled, seedless zucchini ribbons that cook down into silk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown ground pork or turkey with ground ginger, garlic powder, soy sauce, and a drop of sesame oil. Add peeled zucchini ribbons (seed core removed) and cook until completely translucent and tender.
